verdict.rationale: A Do Not Disturb mode is a fair capability to expect from a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, no item in the evidence pack mentions notifications, notification silencing, or a Do Not Disturb mode. The docs cover installation, encryption, accessibility, remote access and customization, and the community items discuss Unity and GNOME without touching notifications.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can silence notifications using a Do Not Disturb mode
